limits: 512-PE tiles are still aggregate models; changing resolution is not hardware novelty
shared two matrix issue contexts per eight-domain neighborhood; association/FIFO state charged separately
data/control pad sites conserve the baseline; 4-bit forward/reverse control per domain needs serialization
staging repartition conserves bytes/MC slots, not the timing contract or descriptor coverage
new bidirectional local branches cost at least twice the one-way wire proxy; not free activation broadcast
HB landing geometry checked; compute/SRAM macro footprints, clocks, power and area are uncalibrated
global fabric unchanged conceptually; 128 direct endpoints cannot silently reuse the V3 co-located-router compiler

gate.offline_layout: output rows contiguous inside each real domain; no runtime transpose/gather
gate.scale_contract: unique original scale bytes at their owner; other slices receive explicit scale multicast

up.offline_layout: output rows contiguous inside each real domain; no runtime transpose/gather
up.scale_contract: unique original scale bytes at their owner; other slices receive explicit scale multicast

down.offline_layout: output rows contiguous inside each real domain; no runtime transpose/gather

bounds.retained_slice_scaling: For identical lockstep references and proportional sizes, C_i=C/8 and W_i=W/8 give the same collective resident matrix count as a C-sized whole-matrix cache. Original scale ownership/padding can make one domain slightly tighter; neither slicing nor more tag tables pools capacity.
bounds.readiness: Balanced 16-row gate/up slices each take a full domain matrix interval. All eight slices finishing together does not create 128->16 stage pipelining. Earlier per-row outputs form strided sets across tiles; consuming them in Down needs a separate layout/readiness/FP32 accumulation-order contract.
bounds.contract: Cold necessary-work bounds omit startup, ACT/PRE/refresh, control serialization, local fanout, FIFO backpressure, cache, compute dependencies and shared scheduling. Sink bytes are logical replicas, not multicast edge traffic. Output slices concatenate within a block; ordered block/partition accumulation still applies.

next_gate: Whole-matrix local computation already exists. Test bounded Down fetch before any 128-tile execution. A matched 128-tile resolution baseline, local fabric, scale multicast, FIFO/cache and numerical contracts are required for new hardware.
